description: A class that includes Enumerable and defines only `each` answers the methods the prelude module was missing (issue #182): uniq/compact/to_h/minmax_by/each_entry/grep/grep_v/zip, including multi-value and empty `each` yields, minmax_by's pairwise tie ordering, the three distinct to_h/zip refusals, and Hash#to_h's own identity and two-argument block.
